description: This file defines the EmployeeMembership entity class for the OrangeHRM system, using Doctrine ORM annotations. It encapsulates the relationship between an employee and their memberships, including details such as subscription fee, payer, currency, start date, and renewal date.

classes.name: EmployeeMembership
classes.description: Represents an employee's membership details, including subscription information and relations to Employee and Membership entities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the membership record.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee associated with this membership.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this membership.

methods.name: getMembership
methods.description: Returns the Membership entity linked to this record.

methods.name: setMembership
methods.description: Links a Membership to this employee membership record.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Returns who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionPaidBy
methods.description: Specifies who paid for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency used for the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCurrency
methods.description: Sets the currency for the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the date the subscription commenced.

methods.name: setSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the subscription.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the renewal date of the subscription.

methods.name: setSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Sets the renewal date for the subscription.
